decisions.statement: A path with no body is written as an addition.
A path with another body is written over as a replace with the whole body each side.
A path already with the body given is refused rather than written again.
A line of a file of entries arriving without an `id` is given one here.
A line already stating an `id` keeps that `id`.
Whether a path holds entries is read from the module minting an entry's `id`.
Every caller writing a whole body at a path reaches this change to write it.
An `id` is worked out after the body given is weighed against the body there.
A caller may state the body its own body was composed against.
A body stated that is not the body there refuses the change unwritten.
A caller stating no such body is held to nothing and writes over what is there.
Nothing here judges whether a body may be written.

definition: one body written at one path, with the entries in that body given their ids
